financial_flags.finding: Liabilities ($93,508) are about 10.5x total assets ($8,866) at 2026-04-30; stockholders' deficit of roughly $84,642 (derived).
financial_flags.why: Balance sheet is deeply insolvent on a book basis, and the gap has widened each year.

financial_flags.finding: Net losses in all three years (-12,160; -41,049; -27,159) while total assets fell from 49,518 to 8,866.
financial_flags.why: Persistent losses are eroding the small asset base; liquidity is nearly exhausted.

financial_flags.finding: Revenue is tiny and volatile (21,920 → 16,200 → 27,600) against expenses of $54,759.
financial_flags.why: Operations are not self-sustaining; funding relies on advances from the sole executive or equity.

financial_flags.finding: Cash and long-term debt are not available from the data.
financial_flags.why: Liquidity cannot be fully assessed from structured data; operating cash outflow was $22,859 in FY2026.

risks.finding: Auditors have issued a going concern opinion; substantial doubt about continuing for the next twelve months.
risks.evidence_quote: Our auditors have issued a going concern opinion.

risks.finding: Material weakness in internal control: no segregation of duties, no independent directors, no audit committee, no formal review process.
risks.evidence_quote: none of whom are independent under applicable standards; we do not have an audit committee or compensation committee.

risks.finding: Dependence on advances from sole executive or equity issuance; no assurance of financing, with dilution risk.
risks.evidence_quote: We have financed our operations primarily from either advances from our sole executive or the issuance of equity.

risks.finding: Start-up with limited operating history and key-person dependence on a sole executive.
risks.evidence_quote: We are in start-up stage operations and have generated limited revenues.

risks.finding: Financing may be unavailable on acceptable terms, which could force the company to curtail operations.
risks.evidence_quote: We have no assurance that future financing will be available to us on acceptable terms.

red_flags.evidence_quote: Our auditors have issued a going concern opinion.
Our CEO concluded we have a material weakness due to lack of segregation of duties, a limited corporate governance structure
We are not currently a party to any legal proceedings, and we are not aware of any pending or potential legal actions.

rating_rationale: Micro-scale shell-like start-up with a going concern opinion, a confirmed material weakness, liabilities about 10x assets, recurring losses and shrinking assets. It relies on its sole executive's advances for funding. No litigation was found, and restatement and auditor-change searches returned nothing, but the financial fragility is severe. Research only, not investment advice.
open_questions: What are the terms, size and repayment of the sole executive's advances (likely most of the $93,508 liabilities)?
What is the cash balance? It was not available from structured data.
Does the company have a realistic plan or funding for the marketing program it says it needs?
Check Item 9 and the audit report for any auditor change; Item 1A is omitted as a smaller reporting company, so risk coverage is thin.
Is the business viable beyond the mobile app/website? Check Item 1 and the related-party notes.
